messages:
maria: Heads-up: I'm seeing bursts at /v1/embeddings where mixed-dim requests end up slotting into huge batches and backlog. Queue length spikes, then we get 413s and some 500s. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/embeds/slotting?view=burst :eyes:

aj: saw that too during the 09:12 deploy window. queues spiked ~220. splitter logs show many small (64d) + large (4096d) grouped.

sam: can you paste a compact trace? want to check batch sizes and time_in_queue.

maria: ```
[splitter] tenant=acme reqs=120 in=09:11:32 batch=64+4096 mix_bytes=1.2MB queued_ms=480
[router] routed_to=slot-7 reason=weight_imbalance
[runtime] error=413 client=acme payload=1.3MB
```
link to trace: https://traces.internal/redwood/1743219999

kevin: this is the slotting heuristic biting us. we count dims as weight so mixed dims can create a 'heavy' batch that then hits per-GPU bytes cap.

kevin: short-term mitigation: (1) preflight header `x-embed-dim` so ingress can pre-route before batching, (2) cap per-req bytes at 1MB with helpful 400 + hint.

lorna: console/UX note: if we require `x-embed-dim`, console should show "suggested max payload" + example curl and add a flag in the "API keys > tips".

aj: telemetry needs: histogram `embed_batch_bytes`, counter `embed_preflight_mismatch` and gauge `embed_ingress_backlog` with tenant tag. also need alert: backlog > 150 for 3m.

ingest-bot: Alert: embed_ingress_queue_length{env=prod} = 212 > 150 for 3m at 09:15 UTC

sam: rollout plan: canary header opt-in for 5% of traffic (non-enterprise tenants), measure 95th p99 latency and error rate. fallback to old behavior if mismatch_rate > 1%.

maria: I'll open a PR with config changes + dashboard mock (embed_batch_bytes hist + preflight mismatch chart). tagging @kevin @aj for review :thumbsup:

kevin: :shipit: small perf test first, then canary

lorna: I'll add console tooltip copy once PR is up.

aj: adding the alert rule to ops playbook and will schedule a runbook update.

maria: thanks — will attach PR link when ready.
